## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate fails open, so this needs fixing before merge: when the saved results file is missing, `load_results` now returns `[]`, and `release_allowed` then allows the release.

## Changes
This pull request makes `load_results` return an empty list when the results file is missing. It also adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when the preferences file is missing, and adds tests for both functions.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Fail the release gate when the results file is missing — If the results file does not exist, `load_results` returns `[]`, and `all(row["passed"] for row in [])` at `app/results.py:12` evaluates to `True`, so `release_allowed` returns `True` even though no checks ran. None of the added tests uses a missing results path. — A deleted, misnamed or never-written results file lets a release through with no passing checks. — Fix: Keep the `FileNotFoundError` fallback out of `load_results`, or have `release_allowed` return `False` when there are no results; add a missing-file case to `test_saved_checks_control_release`.
